newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Lesrnet buys The Pro Shop for 70.6 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Lesrnet buys The Pro Shop for 70.6 mln rand.

text.p: LeisureNet Ltd said on Friday it had bought gold discounter The Pro Shop with effect from December 1 for 70.66 million rand.
The acquisition further strengthens the Health & Fitness division of LeisureNet and would be paid by the allotment of a maximum of 18.13 million new LeisureNet shares.
It said in the year ended June 30, 1996 The Pro Shop had attributable profit of 4.14 million rand.
The acquisition will have no material effect on LeisureNet's estimated earnings per share for the year ending December 31, 1996.
